sara (AE): Quick sync — Greenline pilot starts Mon. Need minimal prompt inventory + pass/fail evals by Fri EOD.

matt (Sales-Eng): Understood. What are the top objectives?

sara (AE): 1) quality on email summarization + product Q&A + rerank. 2) p50 latency <500ms for short prompts. 3) ballpark cost target <= $0.0008/token.

ana (Solutions): I'll assemble prompt CSV with buckets: summarize, qa_with_sources, rerank. Plan 8 templates each, ~15 eval examples per bucket.

matt (Sales-Eng): Baseline eval config to share with infra: model=redwood-13b-quant, max_tokens=256, batch=8, metrics=[rougeL,f1,ndcg,latency].

ryan (Security): Note for SQA: hosted logs default 30d; Dedicated supports customer KMS and no-logging. If they require deletion audit we need Dedicated/Private.

sara (AE): Pricing Q: 30-day pilot 200k gen tokens/day — hosted vs dedicated estimate?

matt (Sales-Eng): Quick numbers: hosted ~ $0.0009/token => ~$180/day. Dedicated depend on commit; rough $10-14k/mo for smallest pool. I'll confirm.

ana (Solutions): Proposed acceptance metrics: rouge-L >=0.65 (summaries), F1 >=0.78 (entities), NDCG@3 >=0.8 (rerank); p50 <500ms; error rate <1%.

sara (AE): Timeline: Fri EOD prompt CSV + eval harness, Mon-Wed run baseline, Thu review with buyer.

dev-bot: CI: eval harness image built and pushed (sha:0f3a2c).

matt (Sales-Eng): I'll post cost sensitivity table + sizing notes here when ready.

sara (AE): Thanks — tagging @ana @matt @ryan to confirm.

matt (Sales-Eng): Confirmed.

ana (Solutions): Confirmed, will upload CSV.

ryan (Security): Confirmed; will add SQA snippet by Thu.
